{{Quote|So our blood runs as one, I'm Hidden Blade. Our darkness opened and we stepped into metal and rage.|Hidden Blade|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hidden Blade''' was a male [[Esh-kha]] who was born thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. In this time, he became a disciple of a new patriarch known as [[Hallow Voice]] who proposed a new way of thinking that involved peaceful co-existence with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species. However, the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] assembled its military might to crush the Esh-kha threat with the surviving members being placed into [[Prison|stasis]] on the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] similarly captured Hallow Voice and his followers such as Hidden Blade that faced this sentence where they remained conscious but frozen in place for millennia. This changed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] when the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] freed him from stasis.
